upsert.title: Fully funded CAR-T cell therapy trial for canine B-cell lymphoma
upsert.center: LEAH Labs / University of Minnesota / Ohio State University / University of Missouri
upsert.status: Trial open — actively enrolling at three partner institutions
upsert.contacts: LEAH Labs — info@leahlabs.com; enrollment request form on the official site
upsert.funding: LEAH Labs states the trial is fully funded and covers 100% of costs for enrolled families.
upsert.notes: Active therapeutic CAR-T cell trial for dogs diagnosed with B-cell lymphoma. LEAH Labs currently lists three actively enrolling sites: University of Minnesota College of Veterinary Medicine (Minneapolis, MN), Ohio State University College of Veterinary Medicine (Columbus, OH), and University of Missouri Veterinary Health Center (Columbia, MO). Detailed owner-facing inclusion/exclusion criteria are not published on the sponsor page, so investigator prescreening is required.
